command: async page=>{const links=await page.locator('.model-profile-technical a').evaluateAll(xs=>xs.map(a=>({text:a.textContent,href:a.href})));return await page.evaluate(async links=>{const rows=[];for(const a of links){if(new URL(a.href).origin!==location.origin)continue;const r=await fetch(a.href),b=await r.arrayBuffer(),h=await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',b);rows.push({...a,status:r.status,sha256:Array.from(new Uint8Array(h)).map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')});}return rows;},links);}
